I must admit, last update was quite messy. I've decided to break my habit of updating as soon as I am done without properly testing everything. So in the future updates will take a bit more time, but in return will be more stable.

Changelog

  • Shortcut keys:
    • Use the Enter key (default value) to collapse/expand child-comments and also to load new replies.
    • You can now expand media in comments by pressing the expand key: if all media are collapsed they are expanded, if at least one is expanded they are collapsed.
  • The user info header can now be expanded/collapsed by clicking on the ">" and "+" icons placed below the block. This replaces the ">>" and "<<" temporarily used before.
  • Fixed a plethora of issues I had created by adding a CSS hack to the FixExpandImage feature.
  • Added other CSS fixes for Voat in general and for some custom styles in particular (e.g. Scribble).
  • Fixed an old issue that would let user select a submission only by clicking a precise part of the post. Submissions can now be selected by clicking anywhere on it.
  • The feature ShowSubmissionVoatBalance that displays the actual vote balance instead of the up or downvote count (according to your vote) is disabled until I find a suitable solution for it. I'm having a hard time finding one that isn't process-heavy.

And more smaller fixes that you can find in the complete changelog (by clicking the version number in the preference manager).

The extensions still haven't been reviewed on the different platforms, so grab the update from the github repo:

  • Chrome/Opera
  • Firefox

If you are using the userscript, you may need to update manually: click here.
